concept: Snow outside a botanical-conservatory work table; postcard trade photographed past a companion shoulder toward the reference-guided adult woman.

must_show: visible tabletop spans near camera and far seated subject
subject upper torso and face clearly rise above tabletop
table props remain below facial priority
tests.confusion_failure: standing portrait with an incidental table, or tabletop close-up with tiny face

must_show: distinct other-person shoulder at a near frame edge
main subject visibly beyond that shoulder and in clearer focus
main subject faces forward toward near-side companion
tests.confusion_failure: the protagonist merely looking backward over her own shoulder; ambiguous ownership of near shoulder

must_show: main subject hand visibly holds cyanotype postcard
hand and card project toward camera-side recipient in lower foreground
tests.confusion_failure: card lies on table, points laterally, hides the face, or an extra unattached hand holds it

reference_checks: visible dark chin-length bob and wispy fringe
eyes, face shape, and lips remain broadly consistent with appearance reference; no real identity or demographic inference
complexity_checks: cyanotype plant postcard and another drying print
gate_rule: All three keyword tests must be met; missing or partial evidence fails. Appearance and complexity are recorded separately.
